title: List my open wizards and paused runs

guidance: What this browser still holds for you between calls (decision F4, failure-endpoint fallback §11): the guided wizards you started that are still open (dsagent.wizard.*), with how long each has waited for you and when it is released unless you address it (idle for 30 minutes of silence from your connection, or 20 minutes without a call naming it; a sign-in wall ends a wizard after 30 minutes); and the runs you started that wait on something in this browser (a sign-in wall the person must pass, host resource pressure, or your repair of a failed block), with the same pause dsagent.execution.get reports. Also how close the 8-wizard limit is and when the next slot frees by itself. Use it after a restart of your Connector (pass the runToken or wizardToken you kept to the run or wizard you take back), or when dsagent.wizard.start answers WIZARD_LIMIT_REACHED or WIZARD_ALREADY_ACTIVE. Read-only; your own work only, other agents' wizards are counted, never named.

outputSchema.description: Your open wizards, the wizard limit, and your paused runs.

wizards.description: Your open guided wizards, oldest first.

wizardId.description: The wizard; continue it with dsagent.wizard.state (pass its wizardToken after a connection renewal).

phase.description: Its phase, as dsagent.wizard.state reports it.

busy.description: The step running now, when one is; absent when the wizard waits for an answer.

awaitingPerson.description: What it waits for on the page (a click, a sign-in wall: pass-page-check), when it does.

idleSeconds.description: Seconds since your last call naming this wizard.

freesInSeconds.description: Seconds until the wizard is released on its own unless you address it (its session stays with the person; start again with adoptActive to continue).

wallEndsInSeconds.description: Present while a sign-in or verification wall stands on its page: seconds until the wizard ends on that wall unless the person passes it.

limits.description: How close the wizard limit is.

active.description: Guided wizards open right now, yours and other agents'.

max.description: The most that may be open at once.

nextFreeInSeconds.description: Seconds until the oldest open wizard of any agent is released on its own; absent when none is open.

pausedRuns.description: Runs you started that wait on something in this browser, with the pause dsagent.execution.get reports.

executionId.description: The run; read it with dsagent.execution.get / wait (pass its runToken after a connection renewal).

status.description: Its runtime status: paused-auth-interrupt, paused-resource-pressure or paused-agent-repair.

pause.description: What it waits on, who must act and until when: the same object dsagent.execution.get reports as pause (kind auth, resource or agent-repair; handoffId and pageContextId for a repair; handoff under a wall).
